intro: We list {{count}} BA colleges in Maharashtra, both in Pune, where our records show a highest package of at least ₹{{threshold}} lakh: MIT World Peace University and Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce.

These BA colleges in Maharashtra with ₹15 lakh highest package are a short extract, not a full ranking of the top BA colleges in Maharashtra 2026. A high arts offer can come from one media role and is not a typical salary.
listLead: MIT WPU qualifies on a 2022 media-and-communication record, with a highest of ₹44 LPA and no average in our file. Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce qualifies on a 2023 English record, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest of ₹22 LPA.
snapshot: The two programmes are not the same subject. A media and communication degree and an English honours degree lead to different work, even when both clear this threshold in our file.
We do not hold an official placement report in this pass that independently confirms the ₹44 LPA figure, so treat it as a record in our file and confirm it with the university.
firstCollegesLead: Our MIT WPU card may also show a B.A. (Hons) English fee of ₹60,000, which is a different programme from the media-and-communication row that meets this cut. Match the fee and the placement figure to the same course.

compare.heading: How to read highest-package figures for BA colleges in Maharashtra
paragraphs: Arts placements vary widely by subject and by the few roles at the top of a batch. Use the average, the subject and the official report, not the highest figure alone.
bullets: Check whether the figure is for English, media and communication, or another BA subject.
Treat a highest package with no average as incomplete until you see the official report.
Compare these two Pune colleges with the wider BA listing for Maharashtra, which includes colleges that do not meet this cut.
